limitations: Systematic month/role-spelling queries for January–June2025, original LeetCode reports, two original Medium blogs, GFG metadata, and all potentially relevant lower-ID SDE2 links in LeetCode compilation7355849 were inspected. Search results are not proof of exhaustive public coverage.

Search providers frequently returned bot/CAPTCHA failures. Headless Google search recovered January–April discovery, but several May/June and GFG searches were challenged; compiled-list traversal supplied concrete May/June originals instead.

Direct LeetCode requests often returned403. Public r.jina.ai renderings supplied original bodies; actual browser-rendered LeetCode pages supplied missing publication dates. Publication dates are fallback, not asserted interview dates.

Only question-bearing text is retained; generic LP labels, vague undisclosed questions, omitted follow-up constraints and final-loop positions beyond4 are not invented. Similar-but-unspecified coding variants have report-specific keys.

Source rounds that explicitly include OA/screening are offset into final-loop positions, with original labels and notes. Reports labeled only by interview category without ordinal or explicit chronology remain excluded.
Dublin reports have five final interviews; only positions1–4 are included. June6884999 and6763561 have extra repeat interviews outside the requested first four.

For6493437 the role location is Chennai and in-person interview venue is Gurgaon. For6436772 the title states Bangalore/Chennai without resolving one city. For6708128 the URL slug says Hyderabad but visible title/body do not, so location remains Not stated.

No specific GenAI question was found in these qualifying first-person reports; absence in this slice is not evidence Amazon did not ask any.
Two similar Bangalore May/June reports6961911/6961860 share narrative structure but have different interview months and question sets; no claim of confirmed same-candidate cross-post is made.

Pragadheeshwaran Medium report describes three post-OA interviews without explicitly saying final loop. The technical/LLD/HM sequence and joint feedback support inclusion, but it is less explicit than reports using the word loop.
